calls.title: Yuzheng Sun and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Yuzheng Sun will collaborate with Growth Book to create English-language content, adapting his popular Chinese A/B testing materials for a new audience. He agreed to write articles and participate in webinars, with plans to discuss fair compensation for his contributions. Yuzheng emphasized the importance of neutrality in tool recommendations within his growth advisory work to preserve credibility. Ashley highlighted the similarities between Growth Book and Statsig, while also exploring opportunities for AI integration into Growth Book's platform. The meeting concluded with both parties agreeing to formalize their collaboration through article drafts and ongoing communication to enhance visibility and support Growth Book's growth strategy.
calls.keywords: AI course, scalable experimentation, growth advisory, A/B testing, product differentiation, AI evaluation
